population_scope: YouTube global policies and platform-defined activity where noted; independent U.S. adult surveys and vendor creator samples have separate denominators

evidence_levels.label: Operator-documented product and policy mechanics
evidence_levels.permitted: Describe qualified routes, eligibility gates, changed terms and conditional risks
evidence_levels.not_permitted: Infer typical individual approval, profit, violations or personal outcomes

evidence_levels.label: Third-party surveys with stated respondents and geography
evidence_levels.not_permitted: Equate surveyed adult use with global distinct people or creator income

evidence_levels.label: Self-selected/multiplatform creator studies
evidence_levels.permitted: Descriptive respondent statistics and recruitment-bias discussion
evidence_levels.not_permitted: Typical YouTube newcomer profit inclusive of zero earners

evidence_levels.label: Platform-reported viewing and uploads
evidence_levels.permitted: Reproduce dated aggregate units and limitations
evidence_levels.not_permitted: Unique people, causation or a current creator profitability distribution

findings.title: Reach and audience counts are different quantities
findings.supported: U.S. adult survey ever-use and internet-user past-month percentages are sample-defined; Studio unique viewers are owner-only estimates.
findings.unknown: Global deduplicated monthly unique people, signed-out population, complete niche overlaps and country-comparable unique-user rankings

findings.title: Very large public video supply does not identify distinct creators
findings.supported: YouTube Press reports over 20 million uploaded videos daily; this is uploads not unique channels or people.
findings.unknown: Number of active independent creators, first-year channel survival and distribution of meaningful view opportunity

findings.title: Sixteen modeled monetization routes have independent gates
findings.supported: YPP, advertising and commerce routes have different eligibility; new February 2027 entry rules were announced but have not yet taken effect in October 2026.
findings.unknown: Typical probability and time to qualify, per-format newcomer net earnings, individual approval and country feature access

findings.title: Selected surveys do not establish new entrant earnings
findings.supported: CreatorIQ's 2026 vendor survey of 5,095 cross-platform creator respondents reports many below an annual threshold; the sample is not a first-time YouTube cohort.
findings.unknown: Representative YouTube earnings including zero earners, net cash profit, actual production labor costs and share that never monetize

findings.title: Publishing time and topical seasons require distinct inference
findings.supported: YouTube says upload time is not known to affect long-term video viewership; over 30% of 2025 NFL video views occurred in the offseason.
findings.unknown: Causal ideal publishing hour, repeatable seasonal lift, matched country/topic period curves or profit timing

findings.title: Compliance and resilience affect routes but do not set earnings
findings.supported: 2026 YouTube updates address branded labels and temporary restrictions for suspected account compromise; independent legal disclosure duties and recovery conditions remain.
findings.unknown: Creator-level breach incidence, brand deal prevalence, violation rates, compliance cost, and measured revenue losses

findings.title: Traffic-source risk is measurable only from scoped own-channel data
findings.supported: YouTube categorizes browse, suggested, search, direct/unknown and other traffic origins in owner Analytics; study can predefine descriptive concentration indices.
findings.unknown: Typical new-creator source concentration, causal effect of any traffic source and cross-channel income risk

evidence_acceptance_gates.needed: Measure a defensible cohort of all entrants including nonmonetized and zero earners, cash costs and labor hours.
Same-age, same-period, same-unit probability or validated samples for country and niche unique people.
Repeat date- and metric-compatible monthly observations across topic and format groups, plus uncertainty.
Joint actual cash expenses, separate labor, payouts and local settlement per creator-period and zero observation handling.
Revalidate October 2026 official policies before later operational decisions, especially February 2027 announcements.

scope_rules: Each finding must preserve the listed source-family type, period, and population.
No platform aggregate view count is a unique person count.
No mixed-platform respondent survey is a representative YouTube all-entrant cohort.
Platform fees, approval probabilities and taxation cannot be estimated from source summaries alone.
Do not turn missing values into zeros or impute relative performance from incompatible topical observations.
Do not use public materials to infer individual religious, sexual, gender, political or financial attributes.
This reader-facing synthesis is a partial research product; acceptance gates and unknowns remain open.
